predictions.selection: Panathinaikos to win (money line; -15.5 point spread the handicap angle)
predictions.headline: Francisco and Lessort power table-topping Panathinaikos against bottom-ranked Baskonia in Athens
predictions.body: Panathinaikos on the money line—with our -15.5 model spread as the handicap angle—is the standout European basketball play when Round 7 visits Telekom Center Athens on Thursday night. Under returning head coach Zeljko Obradovic, the Greens lead the 20-club EuroLeague at 5-1 with a competition-best +90 differential (528 scored, 438 conceded), paced by guard Sylvain Francisco (15.8 points and 4.5 assists per game) and center Mathias Lessort (19.5 PIR and 6.5 rebounds).
